title: Support, Governance Basics, and Asset Inventory — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces real-time asset change notifications: from resource creation in Compute Engine across Asset Inventory to Cloud Pub/Sub and security event sinks.
routing_rationale: Cloud Asset Inventory listens directly to the Google Cloud control plane, emitting resource creation and metadata change events within seconds.

nodes.label: New VM Provisioned
nodes.detail: Developer spins up new virtual machine instance with custom disk.

nodes.label: CAI Control Plane Listener
nodes.detail: Captures raw resource metadata event directly from Resource Manager API.

nodes.label: asset-changes-topic
nodes.detail: Distributes change notification to registered downstream subscribers.

nodes.label: Compliance Auto-Linter
nodes.detail: Inspects new VM metadata to verify mandatory cost-center and owner tags exist.

steps.title: Resource Event Capture
steps.action: Compute Engine notifies Asset Inventory of new instance creation.
steps.why_traversal: Control plane integration guarantees zero lag in infrastructure asset cataloging.

steps.title: Feed Streaming
steps.action: Asset Inventory generates JSON event detailing resource name, zone, and labels.
steps.why_traversal: Pub/Sub decouples resource tracking from specialized compliance processing.

steps.title: Tag Linting
steps.action: Cloud Function parses labels; confirms required cost-center:ecommerce tag is present.
steps.why_traversal: Automated guardrails enforce organizational metadata governance in real time.

scenarios.label: Untagged VM Quarantined
scenarios.root_cause: VM launched without required environment and owner resource tags.
scenarios.diverted_path: Compliance function shuts down untagged VM after 15 minutes of non-compliance.
scenarios.blast_radius: Only untagged instance stopped; compliant instances unaffected.
scenarios.recovery: Add required labels in instance template or Terraform manifest.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
